geometry_method: provided ACS housing-tract geometry, WKB assumed EPSG:4326, projected to EPSG:5070; water proxy=max(0,min(1,1-ALAND/geometry_area)); water-dominated means >0.50
title: Score-free aggregate edge-case audit for methodology documentation

v2_policy.building: fixed gap 0.01 when provided Overture building count is positive; undefined at zero
v2_policy.candidate_or_target_claim: component distributions only; no assembled candidate, hidden-score accuracy claim, or leaderboard probe
v2_policy.facility_poi_half: mean of defined type expectations P(reference present) * clip(1 - observed / (observed + 1), 0, 1), using fixed pooled priors; establishments half is deliberately excluded
v2_policy.nonfinite_prediction_policy: all reported v2 prediction values are finite and bounded; undefined terms are counted and omitted, never filled into means
v2_policy.partial_composite: diagnostic mean of available v2 transport, building, and facility-half terms; not a complete POI/composite candidate because establishments-half scored use is gated
v2_policy.transport: clip(1 - named_road_km / selected_route_km, 0, 1), undefined when route length is zero
v2_policy.urbanity: finite pct_urban, else pop_urban/pop_total for positive population, else neutral 0.5
